incoming.name: Mount Everest
incoming.excerpt: When Tenzing and Hillary made the first successful summit in 1953, they used bottled oxygen.

incoming.name: Yeti
incoming.excerpt: In 1953, Sir Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay reported seeing large footprints while scaling Mount Everest.

outgoing.name: India
outgoing.excerpt: Tenzing died in Darjeeling (now Darjiling), West Bengal, India in 1986.

outgoing.name: Mount Everest
outgoing.excerpt: He and Edmund Hillary were the first men to reach the summit of Mount Everest on 29 May 1953.

outgoing.name: Nepal
outgoing.excerpt: Tenzing Norgay ( 29 May(?) 1914 – 9 May 1986), often referred to as Sherpa Tenzing, was a Nepalese Sherpa mountaineer.

outgoing.name: Tibet
outgoing.excerpt: He took part as a high-altitude porter in three official British attempts to climb Everest from the northern Tibetan side in the 1930s.
